verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS incident-management platform, but the evidence pack never documents such a control. The closest item is the AI & Agents settings page, which describes a team-wide AI opt-in and per-feature AI toggles. That governs AI features, not telemetry or usage tracking, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
